metadata.title: Urban Soul Portrait with Hairline Typography

retrievalProfile.description: A high-key urban portrait featuring a side-profile subject and ultra-thin, large-scale sans-serif typography that overlaps the figure.

recipe.visualDefinition: A male subject in a black button-down shirt and sunglasses is captured in a side profile against a light, desaturated brick wall. Large, ultra-thin white typography is layered over the subject's torso, creating a sophisticated interplay between the figure and the graphic elements.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject positioned right-of-center looking away from the camera
Large-scale typography spanning the horizontal width of the frame
Text layers both behind and in front of the subject's silhouette
High-key, soft lighting minimizing harsh shadows on the background
coreInvariants: Ultra-thin (hairline) stroke weight for primary text
Desaturated, neutral color palette (blacks, grays, whites)

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is medium-shot, seated, occupying the right two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and sunglasses serve as the primary focal point, anchored by the dark mass of the shirt.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes follow the subject's gaze to the right, then sweep left across the large typographic blocks.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample negative space on the left and top, filled with light-colored brick textures.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation throughout; high value contrast between the black shirt and the light background.

letterConstructionRules: Large scale relative to the frame
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'Q' features a simple diagonal tick
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family using weight contrast (Hairline for display, Light for metadata).

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the clean geometric structure and circular 'O's.
Classic geometric proportions that match the skeletal structure.
Modern open-source alternative with the required thinness.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a man in a black shirt and sunglasses, side profile, against a light-colored, softly lit brick wall. Leave space on the left for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply large-scale, white, hairline-weight geometric sans-serif text in all caps. Stack the words and allow them to overlap the subject's chest and arm.

verificationChecks: Is the text stroke weight extremely thin?
Is the subject in a side profile?
Is the background a light-colored brick texture?
Does the text overlap the subject?

mustRedesign: Any specific artist names or logos
Exact facial features of the individual

mustAchieve: Sharp focus on the subject's profile

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the white text is legible against both the black shirt and light wall.
Check that the subject's profile is not obscured by the text.
Verify the geometric circularity of the 'O' and 'C' characters.
Confirm the lighting remains soft and high-key.
